/* ═══ Logo-matched colors: dark green-black bg, bright neon green accent ═══ */ :root{ --bg:#021006; --sb:#041508; --card:#071d0b; --brd:rgba(0,255,65,0.28); --g:#00FF41; --gd:#00CC33; --glow:0 0 22px rgba(0,255,65,0.55); --glow2:0 0 40px rgba(0,255,65,0.75); --red:#FF4444;--ora:#FFA500;--pur:#CC44FF;--blu:#5865F2; --txt:#d8fde4;--muted:rgba(180,255,200,0.38); } *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;} html,body{height:100%;background:var(--bg);color:var(--txt);font-family:'Courier New',monospace;overflow-x:hidden;} /* ── LOADING ── */ #ls{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:9999;transition:opacity .9s;} #ls.gone{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;} .ls-ring-wrap{position:relative;width:160px;height:160px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:18px;} .ls-r1{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid transparent;border-top-color:var(--g);border-right-color:rgba(0,255,65,.4);animation:spin 1.2s linear infinite;} .ls-r2{position:absolute;inset:10px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid transparent;border-bottom-color:rgba(0,255,65,.25);animation:spin 2.2s linear infinite reverse;} #ls-canvas{width:128px;height:128px;border-radius:50%;animation:lpulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;} @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}} @keyframes lpulse{0%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px var(--g));}50%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 35px var(--g));}} .ltxt{color:var(--g);font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:6px;text-transform:uppercase;animation:flk 1.1s infinite;} @keyframes flk{0%,100%{opacity:1}48%,52%{opacity:.2}} .lbar{width:180px;height:2px;background:rgba(0,255,65,.1);margin-top:12px;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;} .lfill{height:100%;background:var(--g);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--g);animation:ld 2.5s ease-out forwards;} @keyframes ld{from{width:0}to{width:100%}} /* ── TOPBAR ── */ #app{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:100%;} #topbar{ height:52px;background:rgba(2,14,6,.98);border-bottom:1px solid var(--brd); display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 16px;gap:12px; position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:200;backdrop-filter:blur(16px); } .tb-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--g);font-weight:bold;font-size:.92rem;letter-spacing:2px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,255,65,.5);} #tl-canvas{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;} .tb-sep{width:1px;height:26px;background:var(--brd);flex-shrink:0;} .tb-title{color:rgba(0,255,65,.4);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:1px;white-space:nowrap;} .tb-disc{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;} .disc-link{background:var(--blu);color:#fff;border:none;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.74rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-decoration:none;font-family:inherit;transition:all .2s;} .disc-link:hover{background:#4752C4;transform:translateY(-1px);} .tb-avatar{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--g);} .tb-name{color:var(--g);font-size:.74rem;max-width:80px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;} /* ── SIDEBAR — no items section, just account+mod ── */ #body{display:flex;padding-top:52px;min-height:100vh;} #sidebar{ width:195px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--sb);border-right:1px solid var(--brd); padding:12px 7px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px; position:fixed;top:52px;bottom:0;left:0;overflow-y:auto;z-index:50; } .sb-section{margin-bottom:6px;} .sb-hdr{color:rgba(0,255,65,.45);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:6px 8px 4px;font-weight:bold;} .sb-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;color:rgba(180,255,200,.42);font-size:.77rem;letter-spacing:.5px;transition:all .17s;border:1px solid transparent;} .sb-item:hover{background:rgba(0,255,65,.1);color:var(--txt);} .sb-item.act{background:rgba(0,255,65,.15);color:var(--g);border-color:rgba(0,255,65,.28);text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,255,65,.4);} .sb-icon{font-size:.88rem;width:17px;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0;} .sb-badge{margin-left:auto;background:var(--ora);color:#000;font-size:.58rem;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:bold;} .sb-div{height:1px;background:var(--brd);margin:6px 4px;} /* ── CONTENT ── */ #content{flex:1;margin-left:195px;padding:24px;max-width:100%;} .pg{display:none;animation:fi .22s ease;}.pg.act{display:block;} @keyframes fi{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}} .ptitle{color:var(--g);font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:3px;margin-bottom:16px;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--g);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;} .ptitle::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--brd);} /* ── SEARCH BAR ── */ .search-wrap{position:relative;margin-bottom:18px;} .search-wrap input{ width:100%;background:rgba(0,24,8,.75);border:1px solid var(--brd); color:var(--txt);padding:10px 16px 10px 42px;border-radius:9px; font-size:.84rem;font-family:inherit;transition:all .2s; } .search-wrap input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--g);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,255,65,.18);background:rgba(0,30,10,.85);} .search-wrap input::placeholder{color:rgba(0,255,65,.3);} .search-icon{position:absolute;left:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:rgba(0,255,65,.45);font-size:1rem;pointer-events:none;} /* ── CATEGORY PILLS (items page) ── */ .cat-pills{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px;} .cat-pill{padding:5px 14px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid var(--brd);background:transparent;color:rgba(0,255,65,.5);cursor:pointer;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:1px;font-family:inherit;transition:all .2s;} .cat-pill.act,.cat-pill:hover{background:var(--g);color:#000;border-color:var(--g);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,255,65,.45);font-weight:bold;} /* ── ITEMS GRID ── */ .igrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(172px,1fr));gap:14px;} .icard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--brd);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;transition:all .22s;} .icard:hover{border-color:var(--g);box-shadow:var(--glow);transform:translateY(-4px);} .icard img{width:100%;height:138px;object-fit:contain;background:rgba(0,18,6,.65);padding:10px;} .icb{padding:11px;} .icn{color:var(--g);font-size:.74rem;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:3px;} .icc{font-size:.63rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:1px;} .cbt{width:100%;margin-top:8px;padding:7px;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--g);color:var(--g);border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.71rem;letter-spacing:1px;font-family:inherit;transition:all .2s;} .cbt:hover{background:var(--g);color:#000;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,255,65,.4);} .no-results{text-align:center;padding:40px;color:rgba(0,255,65,.25);font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:2px;} /* ── HOME — VSL-style ── */ #pg-home{padding:0;} .home-full{ position:relative;min-height:calc(100vh - 52px); display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center; padding:40px 24px 60px;overflow:hidden;text-align:center; } .home-full::before{ content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 35%,rgba(0,255,65,.08) 0%,transparent 50%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 70%,rgba(0,255,65,.05) 0%,transparent 50%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 5%,rgba(0,255,65,.07) 0%,transparent 45%); } .home-full::after{ content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none; background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(0,255,65,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,255,65,.025) 1px,transparent 1px); background-size:40px 40px; } .home-inner{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;max-width:800px;} .home-label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:var(--g);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:3px;margin-bottom:22px;opacity:.7;} .home-label::before{content:'';width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--g);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--g);animation:blink 2s infinite;} @keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.25}} .home-h1{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4.5vw,3.2rem);font-weight:900;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-0.5px;margin-bottom:14px;color:#fff;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;} .home-h1 .accent{color:var(--g);text-shadow:0 0 28px var(--g),0 0 60px rgba(0,255,65,.3);} .home-sub{color:rgba(180,255,200,.5);font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:22px;max-width:500px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;} .home-stats{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:22px;margin-bottom:36px;font-size:.72rem;color:rgba(0,255,65,.42);letter-spacing:1px;} .home-stats span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;} .home-stats span::before{content:'●';color:var(--g);font-size:.55rem;} /* PRIMARY CARD */ .home-card-primary{background:rgba(0,22,8,.88);border:1px solid rgba(0,255,65,.32);border-radius:14px;padding:22px 26px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s;margin-bottom:16px;text-align:left;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);width:100%;} .home-card-primary:hover{border-color:var(--g);background:rgba(0,32,12,.92);box-shadow:var(--glow2),0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.4);transform:translateY(-2px);} .hcp-icon{width:52px;height:52px;background:rgba(0,255,65,.12);border:1px solid rgba(0,255,65,.3);border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.4rem;flex-shrink:0;} .hcp-text{flex:1;} .hcp-title{color:#fff;font-size:1rem;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:4px;} .hcp-sub{color:rgba(180,255,200,.42);font-size:.76rem;} .hcp-arrow{color:var(--g);font-size:1.4rem;flex-shrink:0;} /* ITEMS PANEL on home — with category tiles */ .home-items-panel{background:rgba(0,18,7,.82);border:1px solid rgba(0,255,65,.2);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 22px;margin-bottom:16px;text-align:left;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);} .hip-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:16px;} .hip-title{color:#fff;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:bold;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;} .hip-count{color:rgba(0,255,65,.5);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:1px;} .hip-link{color:var(--g);font-size:.72rem;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;transition:opacity .2s;} .hip-link:hover{opacity:.7;} .cat-tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(110px,1fr));gap:10px;} .cat-tile{background:rgba(0,255,65,.07);border:1px solid rgba(0,255,65,.18);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 10px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:all .2s;} .cat-tile:hover{background:rgba(0,255,65,.14);border-color:var(--g);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(0,255,65,.25);transform:translateY(-2px);} .cat-tile-icon{font-size:1.5rem;margin-bottom:7px;} .cat-tile-name{color:var(--g);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:1px;font-weight:bold;} .cat-tile-count{color:rgba(0,255,65,.4);font-size:.62rem;margin-top:3px;} /* SECONDARY CARDS */ .home-cards-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;} .home-card-sec{background:rgba(0,16,6,.8);border:1px solid rgba(0,255,65,.18);border-radius:13px;padding:20px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .22s;text-align:left;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);} .home-card-sec:hover{border-color:rgba(0,255,65,.42);background:rgba(0,24,9,.88);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.35);} .hcs-icon{width:40px;height:40px;background:rgba(0,255,65,.1);border:1px solid rgba(0,255,65,.2);border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:14px;} .hcs-title{color:#fff;font-size:.86rem;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:5px;} .hcs-sub{color:rgba(180,255,200,.35);font-size:.7rem;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:12px;} .hcs-link{color:var(--g);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;} /* ── TICKETS ── */ .tlist{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;} .tcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--brd);border-radius:9px;padding:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;} .tcard::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;} .tc-p::before{background:var(--ora);}.tc-a::before{background:var(--g);}.tc-r::before{background:var(--red);}.tc-s::before{background:var(--pur);} .tcard img{width:48px;height:48px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(0,18,6,.7);} .ti{flex:1;min-width:0;} .ti-name{color:var(--g);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:2px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;} .ti-meta{color:var(--muted);font-size:.66rem;line-height:1.5;} .tst{padding:3px 9px;border-radius:13px;font-size:.63rem;letter-spacing:1px;font-weight:bold;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;} .ts-p{background:rgba(255,165,0,.1);color:var(--ora);border:1px solid var(--ora);} .ts-a{background:rgba(0,255,65,.12);color:var(--g);border:1px solid var(--g);} .ts-r{background:rgba(255,68,68,.1);color:var(--red);border:1px solid var(--red);} .ts-s{background:rgba(204,68,255,.1);color:var(--pur);border:1px solid var(--pur);} /* ── ADMIN ── */ .stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(105px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:18px;} .stat{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--brd);border-radius:9px;padding:14px;text-align:center;} .stat-n{font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--g);font-weight:bold;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--g);} .stat-l{color:var(--muted);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:2px;} .tabs{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--brd);border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:15px;} .tab{flex:1;padding:7px 4px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:.67rem;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--muted);background:transparent;border:none;font-family:inherit;transition:all .17s;border-right:1px solid var(--brd);} .tab:last-child{border-right:none;}.tab.act,.tab:hover{background:rgba(0,255,65,.12);color:var(--g);} .atcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--brd);border-radius:9px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;} .atcard img{width:42px;height:42px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(0,18,6,.7);flex-shrink:0;} .ati{flex:1;min-width:0;} .atn{color:var(--g);font-size:.76rem;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:2px;} .atm{color:var(--muted);font-size:.65rem;line-height:1.5;} .atac{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;} .bacc{padding:4px 10px;background:rgba(0,255,65,.1);border:1px solid var(--g);color:var(--g);border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.66rem;font-family:inherit;transition:all .17s;} .bacc:hover{background:var(--g);color:#000;} .brej{padding:4px 10px;background:rgba(255,68,68,.08);border:1px solid var(--red);color:var(--red);border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.66rem;font-family:inherit;transition:all .17s;} .brej:hover{background:var(--red);color:#fff;} .bscam{padding:4px 10px;background:rgba(204,68,255,.08);border:1px solid var(--pur);color:var(--pur);border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.66rem;font-family:inherit;transition:all .17s;} .bscam:hover{background:var(--pur);color:#fff;} .batch{background:rgba(0,12,5,.65);border:1px solid var(--brd);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px;} .bth{color:var(--g);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;} .bte{color:rgba(0,255,65,.55);font-size:.68rem;padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,255,65,.07);word-break:break-all;} .bte:last-child{border-bottom:none;} .mcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--brd);border-radius:9px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:7px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;} .mcard-info{flex:1;} .mcard-name{color:var(--g);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:bold;} .mcard-meta{color:var(--muted);font-size:.64rem;} .role-owner{background:rgba(255,215,0,.14);color:#FFD700;border:1px solid #FFD700;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:8px;font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:1px;} .role-admin{background:rgba(0,255,65,.12);color:var(--g);border:1px solid var(--g);padding:2px 7px;border-radius:8px;font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:1px;} .bkick{padding:4px 10px;background:rgba(255,68,68,.08);border:1px solid var(--red);color:var(--red);border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.66rem;font-family:inherit;transition:all .17s;} .bkick:hover{background:var(--red);color:#fff;} /* ── MODAL ── */ .mover{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.92);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:800;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .22s;padding:14px;} .mover.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:all;} .modal{background:#031204;border:1px solid var(--g);border-radius:13px;padding:22px;width:100%;max-width:430px;box-shadow:0 0 50px rgba(0,255,65,.15);transform:scale(.9) translateY(15px);transition:transform .24s;} .mover.open .modal{transform:scale(1) translateY(0);} .modal h2{color:var(--g);font-size:.88rem;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:15px;text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--g);} .fgrp{margin-bottom:11px;} .fgrp label{display:block;color:rgba(0,255,65,.55);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:4px;} .fgrp input,.fgrp textarea,.fgrp select{width:100%;background:rgba(0,18,7,.8);border:1px solid var(--brd);color:var(--txt);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:7px;font-size:.82rem;font-family:inherit;transition:border-color .18s;} .fgrp input:focus,.fgrp textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--g);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,255,65,.18);} .fgrp input.err{border-color:var(--red)!important;} .fgrp select option{background:#031204;} .hint{font-size:.65rem;color:rgba(0,255,65,.3);margin-top:3px;} .warn-box{background:rgba(255,165,0,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,165,0,.4);border-radius:7px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--ora);margin-bottom:11px;line-height:1.5;} .warn-box strong{display:block;margin-bottom:2px;letter-spacing:1px;} .mbtns{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;} .bcanc{flex:1;padding:9px;background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:var(--muted);border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:all .17s;} .bcanc:hover{border-color:rgba(0,255,65,.3);color:var(--txt);} .bsub{flex:2;padding:9px;background:var(--g);border:none;color:#000;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:1px;font-family:inherit;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(0,255,65,.35);transition:all .2s;} .bsub:hover{box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(0,255,65,.65);transform:translateY(-1px);} .bsub:active{transform:scale(.97);} /* ── LOOKUP ── */ .lu-row{display:flex;gap:9px;margin-bottom:13px;} .lu-row input{flex:1;background:rgba(0,18,7,.8);border:1px solid var(--brd);color:var(--txt);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:7px;font-size:.82rem;font-family:inherit;transition:border-color .18s;} .lu-row input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--g);} .lu-info{background:rgba(0,255,65,.05);border:1px solid var(--brd);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:11px;font-size:.71rem;color:rgba(0,255,65,.55);} .lu-info span{color:var(--g);font-weight:bold;} /* ── MISC ── */ .empty{text-align:center;padding:36px;color:rgba(0,255,65,.22);font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:2px;} .lreq{text-align:center;padding:48px 18px;} .lreq h2{color:var(--g);margin-bottom:8px;font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:2px;} .lreq p{color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:15px;font-size:.74rem;} .adeny{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:48vh;text-align:center;} .adeny h2{color:var(--red);font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:3px;margin-bottom:5px;} .adeny p{color:rgba(255,68,68,.45);font-size:.74rem;} #toast{position:fixed;bottom:18px;right:18px;background:rgba(0,12,5,.98);border:1px solid var(--g);color:var(--g);padding:10px 15px;border-radius:8px;font-size:.74rem;z-index:3000;transform:translateX(130%);transition:transform .24s ease;max-width:235px;box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(0,255,65,.22);} #toast.show{transform:translateX(0);} #toast.err{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red);} .btn-g{background:transparent;color:var(--g);border:1px solid var(--g);padding:9px 22px;border-radius:7px;font-size:.77rem;letter-spacing:1px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:all .2s;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;} .btn-g:hover{background:var(--g);color:#000;box-shadow:var(--glow);} .spinner{display:inline-block;width:11px;height:11px;border:2px solid rgba(0,255,65,.2);border-top-color:var(--g);border-radius:50%;animation:spin .6s linear infinite;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:4px;} .copy-btn{padding:3px 8px;background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(0,255,65,.28);color:rgba(0,255,65,.52);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.62rem;font-family:inherit;transition:all .17s;} .copy-btn:hover{color:var(--g);border-color:var(--g);} .scam-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;background:rgba(204,68,255,.1);border:1px solid var(--pur);color:var(--pur);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:7px;font-size:.58rem;} ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px;}::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg);}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(0,255,65,.32);border-radius:2px;} @media(max-width:680px){#sidebar{display:none;}#content{margin-left:0;padding:13px;}.home-cards-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.cat-tiles{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}} /* VSL-style items card */ .home-vsl-card { background: rgba(0,22,8,.88); border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,65,.2); border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: all .25s; text-align: left; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); margin-bottom: 16px; width: 100%; /* Ensures it fills available space cleanly */ box-sizing: border-box; /* Prevents padding from causing overflow/breaking */ } .home-vsl-card:hover { border-color: rgba(0,255,65,.48); background: rgba(0,32,12,.92); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,255,65,.15), 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.35); transform: translateY(-2px); } .hvsl-icon-wrap { margin-bottom: 16px; } .hvsl-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; background: rgba(0,255,65,.12); border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,65,.25); border-radius: 10px; font-size: 1.15rem; } .hvsl-title { color: #fff; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 6px; letter-spacing: .3px; } .hvsl-sub { color: rgba(180,255,200,.42); font-size: .78rem; line-height: 1.55; margin-bottom: 16px; } .hvsl-link { color: var(--g); font-size: .76rem; letter-spacing: .5px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; } .hvsl-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } /* MOBILE BREAK FIX: Adjusts layout automatically on phone screens */ @media (max-width: 768px) { .home-vsl-card { padding: 16px; /* Smaller padding on phones so it doesn't overflow */ margin-bottom: 12px; } }
